name: Jethet
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Jethet is a person mentioned in the Bible's genealogies as a descendant of Judah through the line of Hezron. He is the father of Amaziah and is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in connection with the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah. His role in the biblical context is primarily genealogical, serving as a link in the important lineage from Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jethet is mentioned in the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles as part of the lineage that carried forward important family traditions in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor in the Line of Judah
keyEvents.description: Jethet is part of the broader genealogy of the tribe of Judah, preserved to document Israel's tribal history and inheritance rights.

keyEvents.title: Father of Amaziah
keyEvents.description: Jethet is known as the father of Amaziah, and his place in the genealogy highlights his significance as a connecting link in the lineage of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Israel's Tribal Records
keyEvents.description: As part of the extensive genealogies in 1 Chronicles, Jetet contributes to the historical documentation of the people of Israel after their return from exile.
